exploreUrl:
<js>
(() => {
    let html = java.ajax("https://bbxxxx.com/"); 
    
    // 阅读 App 在执行发现页 JS 时，可以直接通过变量 page 获取当前页码
    // 如果 page 未定义，默认设为 1
    let p = (typeof page !== 'undefined') ? page : 1;

    const getUrl = (baseUrl) => {
        // 第一页保持原样，后续页码拼接 {{page}}.html
        // 注意：这里直接返回字符串结果，避免在字符串内部嵌套引号
        return p == 1 ? baseUrl : baseUrl + p + ".html";
    };

    let list = [
        { "title": "最新", "url": getUrl("https://bbxxxx.com/rank/new/{{page}}.html"), "style": { "layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25 } },
        { "title": "热门", "url": getUrl("https://bbxxxx.com/rank/hot/{{page}}.html"), "style": { "layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25 } },
        { "title": "完本", "url": getUrl("https://bbxxxx.com/rank/complete/{{page}}.html"), "style": { "layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25 } }
    ];
    
    // 分类
    list.push({ "title": "分类", "url": "", "style": { "layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1 } });
    let reg1 = /<a href="(\/category\/\d+\/)">(.*?)<\/a>/g;
    let match1;
    while ((match1 = reg1.exec(html)) !== null) {
        list.push({
            "title": match1[2],
            "url": getUrl("https://bbxxxx.com" + match1[1]) + "/{{page}}.html" +  ",{\"webView\":true}",
            "style": { "layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.2 }
        });
    }

    // 标签
    list.push({ "title": "标签", "url": "", "style": { "layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1 } });
    let reg = /<a href="(\/tag\/\d+\/)">(.*?)<\/a>/g;
    let match;
    while ((match = reg.exec(html)) !== null) {
        list.push({
            "title": match[2],
            "url": getUrl("https://bbxxxx.com" + match[1]) + "/{{page}}.html" + ",{\"webView\":true}",
            "style": { "layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.2 }
        });
    }
    
    return JSON.stringify(list);
})()
</js>

<js>
var bookid = baseUrl.match(/novel\/(\d+)/)[1];
//书评发送
const bookva = book.getVariable("custom");
if (bookva && bookva != "") {
    if (source.getLoginHeader()) {
        const commenturl = `${GetUL()}/home/comment/add.html`;
        let body = `content=${bookva}&type=novel&mid=${bookid}`;
        
        try {
            const code = String(java.getVerificationCode(`data:image/svg+xml;base64,${codesvg}`));
            
            if (code == "评论" || /^@\d+$/.test(code)) {
                if (/^@\d+$/.test(code)) {
                    body += `&pid=${code.match(/(\d+)/)[1]}`;
                }
                
                const headers = { "x-requested-with": "XMLHttpRequest" };
                const response = java.post(commenturl, body, headers).body();
                java.toast(JSON.parse(response).msg);
            } else {
                Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(40);
                java.toast('请按图片要求填写');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            java.log(err);
        }
    } else {
        java.toast("未登录，请登录后操作");
    }
    book.putCustomVariable("");
}

try {
    sourceinfo = source.getLoginInfoMap();
    sourceinfo['书籍ID'] = bookid;
    if (bookid) {
        source.putLoginInfo(JSON.stringify(sourceinfo));
    }
    $ = _ => String(java.getString(_));
    img = /^https?/.test($('[property$=image]@content')) ? $('[property$=image]@content') : GetUL() + $('[property$=image]@content');
    list = {
        "ID": bookid,
        "img": img,
        "name": $('[property$=book_name]@content'),
        "author": $('[property$=author]@content'),
        "info": $('[property$=description]@content').slice(0, 45),
        "url": "legado://import/addToBookshelf?src=" + baseUrl
    }
    source.put("list", JSON.stringify(list));
} catch (err) {
    java.log("登录UI未初始化保存数据：" + err);
}
src;
</js>

<js>
if(result.match(/百度安全验证/)){
	xb=(baseUrl)+","+JSON.stringify({
		"headers":{
			"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86 64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/127.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
}})
java.startBrowserAwait(xb,"验证")
result=java.ajax(xb)
	}

var bookList = [];
var finalJsonOutput = null;
try {
    var doc = result;
    if (!doc) {
        throw new Error("无法解析 HTML");
    }
    var containers = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(doc).select("div.c-container.result-op, div.c-container.result");
    java.log("找到 " + containers.size() + " 个");
    for (var i = 0; i < containers.size(); i++) {
        var container = containers.get(i);
        var book = {};
        if (container.hasClass("result-op")) {            
            java.log("处理第 " + (i + 1) + " 个 (result-op)");            
            book.bookUrl = container.attr("mu") || null;             
            var nameElement = container.selectFirst("a");
            if (nameElement) {
                var nameText = nameElement.text().trim();
                book.name = (nameText) ? nameText : "未找到";
                if (!nameText) {
                    //java.log("未找到书名，a 标签内容: " + nameElement.outerHtml());
                }
            } else {
                book.name = "未找到";
                //java.log("未找到书名对应的 a 标签");
            }            
            var authorElement = container.selectFirst("span");
            if (authorElement) {
                var authorText = authorElement.text().trim();
                var prefix = "作者： "; 
                if (authorText.includes(prefix)) {
                    book.author = authorText.substring(prefix.length).trim();
                } else {
                    book.author = "未找到";
                    //java.log("作者信息未找到或格式不符: " + authorElement.outerHtml());
                }
            } else {
                book.author = "未找到";
                //java.log("未找到作者对应的 span 标签");
            }            
            var introElement = container.selectFirst("div.text_2NOr6");
            var introText = null;
            if (introElement) {
                introText = introElement.text().trim();
                book.intro = introText;                 
                book.kind = null; 
                if (!introText.startsWith("简介:")) {
                    var kindPrefix = "类别:";
                    var kindIndex = introText.indexOf(kindPrefix);
                    if (kindIndex !== -1) {
                        var kindTemp = introText.substring(kindIndex + kindPrefix.length).trim();
                        var chapterPrefix = "最新章节"; 
                        var chapterIndex = kindTemp.indexOf(chapterPrefix);
                        if (chapterIndex !== -1) {
                            book.kind = kindTemp.substring(0, chapterIndex).trim(); 
                        } else {
                            book.kind = kindTemp; 
                        }
                    } else {
                        //java.log("未在 intro 文本中找到 '类别:' 用于提取 kind: " + introText);
                    }
                } else {
                    //java.log("intro 文本以 '简介:' 开头，kind 设为 null");
                }
            } else {
                book.intro = null; 
                book.kind = null;
                //java.log("未找到 intro/kind 对应的 div.text_2NOr6 标签");
            }            
            var allAElements = container.select("a");
            if (allAElements.size() >= 2) {
                book.lastChapter = allAElements.get(allAElements.size() - 2).text().trim();
            } else {
                book.lastChapter = null; 
                //java.log("a 标签数量不足，无法提取倒数第二个作为 lastChapter");
            }
        } else if (container.hasClass("result")) {            
            java.log("处理第 " + (i + 1) + " (result)");            
            book.bookUrl = container.attr("mu") || null;            
            var nameElement = container.selectFirst("a");
            if (nameElement) {
                var nameText = nameElement.text().trim();
                book.name = (nameText) ? nameText : "未找到";
                if (!nameText) {
                   //java.log("未找到书名，a 标签内容: " + nameElement.outerHtml());
                }
            } else {
                book.name = "未找到";
                //java.log("未找到书名对应的 a 标签");
            }            
            var contentRightElement = container.selectFirst(".content-right_1THTn");
            if (contentRightElement) {
                var fullText = contentRightElement.text().trim();
                book.intro = fullText;                 
                book.author = null; 
                var authorPrefix = "作者:"; 
                var authorIndex = fullText.indexOf(authorPrefix);
                var kindSeparator = "类别"; 
                var kindIndexForAuthor = fullText.indexOf(kindSeparator);
                if (authorIndex !== -1) { 
                    var startIndex = authorIndex + authorPrefix.length;
                    var endIndex = (kindIndexForAuthor !== -1 && kindIndexForAuthor > authorIndex) ? kindIndexForAuthor : fullText.length;
                    book.author = fullText.substring(startIndex, endIndex).trim();
                } else {
                    //java.log("未在 .content-right_1THTn 中找到 '作者:'");
                }                
                book.kind = null; 
                var kindPrefix = "类别:"; 
                var kindIndex = fullText.indexOf(kindPrefix);
                var chapterSeparator = "最新章节"; 
                var chapterIndexForKind = fullText.indexOf(chapterSeparator);
                if (kindIndex !== -1) { 
                    var startIndex = kindIndex + kindPrefix.length;
                    var endIndex = (chapterIndexForKind !== -1 && chapterIndexForKind > kindIndex) ? chapterIndexForKind : fullText.length;
                    book.kind = fullText.substring(startIndex, endIndex).trim();
                } else {
                    //java.log("未在 .content-right_1THTn 中找到 '类别:'");
                }                
                book.lastChapter = null; 
                var chapterPrefix = "最新章节:"; 
                var chapterIndex = fullText.indexOf(chapterPrefix);
                var updateSeparator = "最新更新"; 
                var updateIndex = fullText.indexOf(updateSeparator);

                if (chapterIndex !== -1) { 
                    var startIndex = chapterIndex + chapterPrefix.length;
                    var endIndex = (updateIndex !== -1 && updateIndex > chapterIndex) ? updateIndex : fullText.length;
                    book.lastChapter = fullText.substring(startIndex, endIndex).trim();
                } else {
                    //java.log("未在 .content-right_1THTn 中找到 '最新章节:'");
                }
            } else {                
                book.author = null;
                book.kind = null;
                book.lastChapter = null;
                book.intro = null;
                //java.log("未找到 .content-right_1THTn 元素");
            }
        } else {
            //java.log("跳过未知类型的容器: " + container.outerHtml().substring(0, 100));
            continue; 
        }        
        bookList.push(book);
    }
    var finalResult = {
        bookList: bookList 
    };
    finalJsonOutput = JSON.stringify(finalResult);
} catch (e) {
    java.log("错误: " + e);
    finalJsonOutput = JSON.stringify({
        bookList: []
    }); 
}
result = finalJsonOutput;
</js>

time = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString()

function getSign (key, type, num) {
  const { java } = this
  const secret = 'magic2019'
  let baseString

  switch (type) {
    case 's':
      baseString = `channel=ft0001&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=0&query=${java.encodeURI(key)}&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 't':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&gid=1&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 'c':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&chapterid=${num}&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    default:
      throw new Error('Invalid type')
  }

  return java.md5Encode(baseString).toUpperCase()
}

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
base = baseUrl;
id = baseUrl.match(/(\d+\/)/)[1]
java.put("id",id)
lis = java.getElements('#list-chapterAll@dd');
var list = [];

for (var i = 0; i < lis.length; i++) {
     var href = lis[i].select('a').attr('href');
     var text = lis[i].text();
     if (href==0) {
        if ( i < lis.length - 1 ) {
            var url = "https://www.baidu.com/" + id + lis[i + 1].select('a').attr('href');         
        } else {
            var url = "https://cn.bing.com/" + id + lis[i - 1].select('a').attr('href');
        }
     } else { var url = base + href; }
     java.log(lis[i].text()+":"+url);
     list.push({"text": text, "href": url});
}

list
</js>

<js>
var html = result;
// 提取所有 qsbs.bb('...') 中的加密字符串
var pattern = /qsbs\.bb\('([^']+)'\)/g;
var match;
var contentParts = [];
while ((match = pattern.exec(html)) !== null) {
    var encoded = match[1];
    // Base64 解码
    var decoded = java.base64Decode(encoded);
    if (decoded) {
        contentParts.push(decoded);
    }
}
// 拼接并处理 HTML 实体
var content = contentParts.join('');
// 解码常见的 HTML 实体
content = content.replace(/ /g, ' ').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/"/g, '"');
result = content;
</js>

javaImport.importPackage(
    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.android.util
);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}

</js>

);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}

      list = String(java.base64Decode(token)).split(/[A-Z]+%/);      
      var x = 0,y = 0; var contents = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < datas.length; i++) {
            if (String(datas[i]).match(/h2/i)) {
                  y = i + 1;                 
                }
            };

            if (list[i] < 5) {

                 x++;

                }
            };                
  content = contents.join("");           
</js>

<js>
if(/暂停搜索/.test(src)){
	java.toast("暂停搜索，启用繁体版搜索");
		url="https://www.hetubook.com";
   key=java.get('key');
   key=java.s2t(key);

  surl= url+"/book/search.php?keyword="+java.encodeURI(key)+"<,&page={{page}}>,";
  surl= surl+JSON.stringify({ "headers":{"Referer": surl} });
src=java.ajax(surl);
bookList=org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(src).select("#body>dd").toArray();	
}
else{
	url=source.getKey().match(/([^#]*)/)[1];	bookList=java.getElements("#body@dd||.list@dd").toArray();
	}

  burl=source.getKey().match(/([^#]*)/)[1];
  bookList.map(a=>{  	
		name=a.select("h4>a").text();
		author=String(a.select("h4>span").text()).replace(/\//g,'');
		intro=a.select(".intro").text();	
		img=a.select("img").attr("src");
		bookUrl=a.select("a").attr("href");
		
//ajax加载，加载较慢，若出错请关闭。
eval(String(source.bookSourceComment));
//A=1;  // 1开启,0关闭
A=A!=0?1:0;
if(A){	
	D=org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(java.ajax(url+bookUrl));
	$=D.select(".book_info>div");	
	kind=String($[1].text()).replace(/(類別|类型)：|(小說|小说)/g,'');
	word=String($[2].text()).replace(/(字數|字数)：/,'');
	chapter=D.select("#dir>dd>a");   
	length=chapter.length;
	lastChapter=chapter[length-1].text();
		}
		else{kind="";word="";lastChapter="";}
		
   data={
			name:name,
			author:author,
			kind:kind,
			word:word,
			lastChapter:lastChapter,
			intro:intro,
			img:img,
			bookUrl:burl+bookUrl
		};		
		return java.t2s(JSON.stringify(data))
		})	
		
</js>

}

<js> 
//注意：一般网站默认首页(即baseUrl)有搜索框，否则请填入搜索页面地址
var url = baseUrl;
if (!baseUrl.match(/^https?:/i)) {
    java.log('\n\n\n\n‼️请填入正确的Url‼️\n\n\n\n');
}
var html = java.ajax(url + ",{'webView': true}");
//java.log(html);
var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);
var form = doc.select('form[action]:not([name~=login]):not([class~=login]):not([id~=login])')[0];
//java.log(form);
var method = form.attr('method');
var action = form.attr('action');
var charset = doc.select('head>meta[charset]').attr('charset');
if (charset == '')
{
    charset = String(doc.select('head>meta[content~=charset=]').attr('content')).replace(/^.*charset=([a-z0-9\-]+).*$/i, 
    '$1');
}
//java.log(method);
//java.log(action);
//java.log(charset);
//桌面版UA
var uaw = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36";
//手机版UA
var uam = "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 7.0; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/48.0.2564.116 Mobile Safari/537.36 T7/10.3 SearchCraft/2.6.2 (baiduboxapp; P1 7.0)";
var headers = {
    //请自行选择UA，↓↓↓填入此处
    "User-Agent" : uam, "Referer" : String(baseUrl)
};
url = baseUrl.replace(/([^\/])$/i, '$1/') + String(action).replace(/^\//, '');
var body = '';
var option = {};
var sk = form.select('input[name][type="text"],input[name][class="text"]').attr('name');
//java.log(sk);
var es = form.select('input[name]:not([type="submit"])');
for (var it in es)
{
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.attr('value');
    if (k == sk) {
        //body+=sk+'={{java.encodeURI(key,\''+ charset+'\');}}&';
        body += sk + '={{key}}&';
    }
    else {
        body += k + '=' + v + '&';
    }
}
es = form.select('select[name]');
for (it in es)
{
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.select('option')[0].attr('value');
    body += k + '=' + v + '&';
}
body = String(body).replace(/&$/, '');
java.log(body);
if (method.match(/post/i))
{
    option = 
    {
        "charset" : String(charset), "method" : String(method), "body" : String(body), "headers" : headers, 
        "webView" : true 
    };
    url += ',' + JSON.stringify(option);
}
else
{
    //get
    option = {
        "charset" : String(charset), "headers" : headers, "webView" : true 
    };
    url += '?' + body + ',' + JSON.stringify(option);
}
java.log(url);

ruleBookInfo.intro:
<js>
r=`走出便利商店要回家的高中生 菜月・昴（Natsuki・Subaru） 突然被召唤到异世界。

这莫非就是很流行的异世界召唤！？可是眼前没有召唤者就算了，还遭遇强盗迅速面临性命危机。

这时，一名神秘银发美少女和猫精灵拯救了一筹莫展的他。

以报恩为名义，昴自告奋勇要帮助少女找回失物。

然而，好不容易才掌握到线索，昴和少女却被不明人士攻击而殒命 ── 本来应该是这样，但回过神来，昴却发现自己置身在第一次被召唤到这个异世界时的所在位置。

『死亡回归』 —— 无力的少年得到的唯一能力，是死后时间会倒转回到一开始。

※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※

仅仅是作为没有被赋予任何关于异世界知识、技能、力量的普通人，挣扎求存。 他唯一得到的祝福就是 「重生」 —— 触发条件是痛苦的 『死亡』 ！

他死了多少次？ 历经多少死亡方式（剧透慎点）？ 在不可靠的世界种如何夺取希望之物？

但即使跨越无数血液、尸体和绝望，也要从死亡的命运中拯救少女！`
</js>

var result = [];
for (var i = 0; i < bes.length; i++) {

    var bsej = java.base64Decode(bes[i]);

      }
var txt = result.join('\n');
}
txt;

time = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString()

function getSign (key, type, num) {
  const { java } = this
  const secret = 'magic2019'
  let baseString

  switch (type) {
    case 's':
      baseString = `channel=ft0001&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=0&query=${java.encodeURI(key)}&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 't':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&gid=1&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 'c':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&chapterid=${num}&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    default:
      throw new Error('Invalid type')
  }

  return java.md5Encode(baseString).toUpperCase()
}

<js>
var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.android.util
);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}

<js>
var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
     Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.java.util 
);
with(javaImport){
    let IV_PARAMETER = String("1ae2c94b");
    let ALGORITHM = "DES"; 
    let CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding";
    let CHARSET = "utf-8";
    let password=String("KK!%G3JdCHJxpAF3%Vg9pN");


function decode(data){
let dks = new DESKeySpec(String(password).getBytes());
let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
let secretKey = keyFactory.generateSecret(dks);
let cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_ALGORITHM);
let iv = new IvParameterSpec(IV_PARAMETER.getBytes(CHARSET));
cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, iv);
return new String(cipher.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(data).getBytes(CHARSET))), CHARSET);

}
}
//DES解密结束

saybody=java.getString("$.sayBody");
say=saybody!=""?"\n作者有话要说：\n"+saybody:"";

result=String(decode(content)+say);

javaImport.importPackage(
    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.android.util
);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}

// 真实链接解密
function decode(str) {
  url = source.getKey() + "/api/app/docs-listen/" + str + "/ting-with-efi"; 
  res = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url));
  id = res.id.replaceAll("-", "");
  efi = res.efi;
  cT = res.creationTime.replace(/[-:T.]/g, "").replace(" ", "").padEnd(20, "0");
// 生成key
function gk(e, t) {
  let n = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    n += String.fromCharCode(e[i].charCodeAt(0) + Number(t[i]));
  }
  for (let i = 20; i < e.length; i++) {
    n += String.fromCharCode(e[i].charCodeAt(0) + Number(t[i - 20]));
  }
  return java.base64Encode(n);
}
// 生成iv
function gi(e, t) {
  let n = "";
  for (let i = 20; i > 4; i--) {
    n += String.fromCharCode(e[i].charCodeAt(0) + Number(t[i - 1]));
  }
  return java.base64Encode(n);
}
  key = gk(id, cT); iv = gi(id, cT);
  ef = (efi + "").replace(/\n*$/g, "").replace(/\n/g, "");
  url = java.aesDecodeArgsBase64Str(ef, key, 'CBC', 'PKCS7Padding', iv);
  return encodeURI(url);
}

url = ipv6 + decode(vid)

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let data=JSON.parse(result).data
let chapterList=[]
for(var volume of data){
	chapterList.push({
		name:volume.volume_name,
		isVolume:true,
		info:volume.volume_desc
		})
		for(var chapter of volume.chapter_list){
			var isVip=chapter.chapter_ispay==0?"":"💰"
			var time=java.timeFormat(chapter.chapter_time*1000)
			chapterList.push({
				name:isVip+chapter.chapter_name,
				isVolume:false,
				info:`更新时间:`+time+` 字数:${chapter.chapter_number}`,
				url:`/api/readWithEncrypt?chapter_id=${chapter.chapter_id}&nid=${chapter.chapter_nid}&preload=0`
				})
			}
	}
chapterList
</js>

    Packages.java.lang,

);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
